source.working_tree_changes: matrix-free bordered Gauss-Newton action/step added locally

decision: The matrix-free operator/GMRES seam is usable and its independently recomputed residual catches the failure; 40 iterations do not certify the full tokamak solve. A 16-probe Hutchinson diagonal is indefinite and makes convergence much worse. Reject both steps. Proceed with physically structured mode/radial block preconditioning, not a larger blind iteration budget.
limitations: This test does not apply the returned correction or report a polished equilibrium.
The force and gauge Jacobians are not materialized in the production operator; only the small-system verification test assembles dense matrices.
